formula: B11 nuclear mass = atomic mass*u -5 electron masses + sum ionization energies

sources.scope: 2022 CODATA proton, alpha, electron and atomic-mass-unit energy equivalents
NIST older isotope-composition mass snapshot, NOT claimed latest AME value
ASD5.12 elemental boron ionization energies; isotope shifts not resolved
Lorentz boosts, recursive phase-space factorization; constant matrix element is OUR null assumption

uncertainty_scope: B11 atomic mass alone implies about0.000419MeV mass uncertainty; no full mass covariance propagation in this reference. Numerical conservation is conditional on nominal masses.
